entries.description: Row label for the pump's Bluetooth MAC address. Shared with Insight overview.
Switch to automatically record battery changes as therapy events.
Switch to automatically record insulin cartridge changes as therapy events.
Battery state value: empty.
Battery state value: full.
Battery state value: low.
Warning that the pump battery is low.
Notification: the driver can't start because Bluetooth is off.
Notification: the driver can't run because the device has no Bluetooth.
Result text: the bolus was cancelled.
Error shown when delivery failed and apparently nothing was delivered; tells the user to check the pump to be sure. Sentences.
Result text: no bolus was delivered.
Button to abort pairing. Short imperative.
Describes the running command: cancelling the temporary basal rate (TBR).
Notification: the stored pairing data is unusable and the pump must be paired again.
Message: the pump showed an error earlier, so the app won't connect until the user clears it on the pump. Sentences.
Failure reason: bolus refused because the pump is suspended.
Explanation why pairing is impossible: the driver isn't initialized (typically because Bluetooth permissions or another startup condition is missing). Sentences.
Failure reason: an absolute TBR (in U/h) cannot be converted to a percentage when the base basal rate is zero.
Driver state: reading the pump's status.
Prefix of the alert notification, followed by a colon and the alert text.
Question asking to confirm cancelling pairing.
Question asking to confirm unpairing.
Error message. %1$s is the technical error description.
Error shown when the app could not connect to the pump. Whole sentence.
Active temporary basal rate. %1$d%% is the percentage, %2$d the remaining minutes.
Active temporary basal rate with less than one minute left. %1$d%% is the percentage.
Reason text for a pump status refresh: date and/or time changed.
Progress text during a bolus. %1$.1f is the delivered amount, %2$.1f the total, both in units (U).
Number setting: how many seconds to scan for the pump. '(in seconds)' states the unit.
Row label for the state of the driver (e.g. Ready, Suspended).
Reason text for a pump status refresh: daylight saving time (DST) ended.
Reason text for a pump status refresh: daylight saving time (DST) started.
Heading asking the user to type the PIN shown on the pump.
Word 'error' placed before the pump's error code, e.g. 'Combo error E4: ...'.
Error E1: insulin reservoir is empty. Short fragment appended after the code.
Error E10: reservoir error. Short fragment appended after the code.
Error E11: infusion set not primed. Short fragment appended after the code.
Error E2: battery is empty. Short fragment appended after the code.
Error E4: occlusion, insulin delivery is blocked. Short fragment appended after the code.
Error E5: end of the backup pump's operation. Short fragment appended after the code.
Error E6: mechanical error. Short fragment appended after the code.
Error E7: electronic error. Short fragment appended after the code.
Error E8: power interrupt. Short fragment appended after the code.
Error E9: end of the loan pump's operation. Short fragment appended after the code.

entries.ui_location: Pairing wizard progress and overview status
entries.description: Progress text while connecting over Bluetooth. %1$d is the attempt number.
Driver state: a command is running.
Failure reason when an extended bolus is requested; the Combo driver does not support it.
Describes the running command: reading total daily dose (TDD) history from the pump.
Progress text. %1$d is the number of hourly basal factors read so far.
Describes the running command: reading the basal profile from the pump.
Button to leave the screen. Short imperative.
Message about an unexpected limit when adjusting a temporary basal rate. Placeholders hold the target and actual percentages and related values.
Says that a 100% TBR request was ignored because normal basal is already active.
Message: the pump's active basal profile is wrong; the driver requires profile 1. %1$d is the number of the profile the pump currently uses.
Failure reason: not enough insulin in the cartridge for the bolus.
Value of the last-connection row when the last contact was seconds ago.
Says that a running emulated 100% TBR is left to finish.
Result text: loading total daily doses (TDD) was cancelled.
Value of the last-connection row. %1$d is the number of minutes.
Driver state: driver not started yet.
Error when a command needs a pump but none is paired.
Title of the entry that opens the pairing wizard.
Result text when pairing stopped without a known cause.
Result text when the user cancelled pairing.
Result text when no pump was found before the scan timed out.
Result text when pairing failed. %1$s is the technical error message.
Success message after pairing.
Progress text while the last pairing steps complete.

entries.ui_location: Combo pairing wizard > title during pairing
entries.description: Title shown while pairing is running.

entries.ui_location: Pairing wizard progress and overview status
entries.description: Progress text while the app and the pump exchange keys and setup messages.
Message shown when the entered PIN was rejected. Advises checking for a typo and cancelling/retrying if it repeats.
Progress text: the pump now displays a 10-digit PIN the user must type.

Numbered instruction list telling the user which pump menus to open to make the pump ready for pairing. Multi-line; keep numbering and line breaks. Menu names should match the pump's display language.

entries.ui_location: Combo pairing wizard > PIN text field
entries.description: Placeholder in the PIN field: the PIN has 10 digits.
One-line plugin description in the pump list.
Plugin name of the Combo driver. Product name.
Failure reason: the pump is suspended (stopped), so the command cannot run.
Driver state: ready for commands.
Reason text for a pump status refresh after an error.
Warning that the insulin reservoir level is low.
Result text: reading total daily doses (TDD) from the pump failed.
Progress text while scanning for the pump over Bluetooth.
The Combo can't set a true 100% TBR, so one is emulated; this says an emulated 100% TBR was set.
Progress text. %1$d is the number of hourly basal factors written so far.
Describes the running command: writing the basal profile to the pump.
Progress text while the app sets the pump's date.
Progress text while the app sets the pump's clock to the time of the phone.
Describes the running command: set a temporary basal rate. %1$d%% is the percentage, %2$d the duration in minutes.
Result text: setting the temporary basal rate (TBR) failed.
Result text: the temporary basal rate (TBR) was set.
Line in the short pump status giving the current alert. %s is the code like W4 or E4.
Button that begins pairing. Short imperative.
Further steps for the pump screen: the phone's name appears there and the user must press the pump's CHECK button. 'CHECK' is a label printed on the pump; keep as it is on the device.
Driver state: the pump is suspended (stopped).
Reason text for a pump status refresh: time zone changed.
Title of the Combo driver's preference screen. Product name.
Safety message: the pump delivered insulin the app did not request, so the current bolus is cancelled.
Warning: a temporary basal rate not started by the app was found and stopped. %1$d%% is its percentage, %2$d the remaining duration.
Summary under 'Unpair pump'. 'AndroidAPS' is the app name; Android means the phone's system pairing list.
Title of the entry that removes the pairing; asks for confirmation.
Text used when the pump shows an alert the driver can't identify.
Describes the running command: updating the pump's date and time.
Describes the running command: reading the pump's status.
Switch to enable extra-detailed logging for troubleshooting.
Word 'warning' placed before the pump's warning code, e.g. 'Combo warning W4: ...'. Followed by a code.
Warning W10: Bluetooth problem, the user must pair again. Appended after the code, so it is a short fragment.
Warning W4: asks the user to call the Accu-Chek hotline for a software update. Appended after the code, so it is a short fragment.
